# Support Guide

Thank you for using Wumpkit! Here are the best ways to get help and support:

## Asking Questions

If you have questions about how to use Wumpkit, how to structure your bot, or need architecture advice:
- Join the community discussions on [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/wumpkit/wumpkit/discussions).
- Check the runnable examples in the [`_examples`](https://github.com/wumpkit/wumpkit/tree/master/_examples) directory.
- Review official package documentation on [pkg.go.dev](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/wumpkit/wumpkit).

## Reporting Bugs

If you have identified a bug or an inconsistency with the Discord API:
- Search [existing issues](https://github.com/wumpkit/wumpkit/issues) to verify it hasn't been reported yet.
- Open a new [Bug Report](https://github.com/wumpkit/wumpkit/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml) with your Go version, operating system, and a minimal reproduction.

## Requesting Features

Have an idea for a feature or an enhancement to the API?
- Submit a [Feature Request](https://github.com/wumpkit/wumpkit/issues/new?template=feature_request.yml) explaining your use case and proposed API design.

## Security Vulnerabilities

Please report all security vulnerabilities privately according to our [Security Policy](https://github.com/wumpkit/wumpkit/blob/master/.github/SECURITY.md).
